OBJECTIVES
This lesson introduces you to percents and teaches you math operations using percents.
INTRODUCTIONM
Percents are commonly used in your every day life..........
THE TIMES
To find out how much 50% off is, you have to change the percent to a form that can be used in math operations.
This involves knowing how to convert between percents and decimal numbers, and knowing how to use the results.
For example, if an item is $5 but on sale for 25% off, you save $1.25.

LESSON MENU
The term percent is used to represent a portion of 100.....
DISCUSSION
The "%'' sign, called percent, tells you the number is a portion or percentage.
The number indicates how much of 100 is used.
500% indicates 500 out of 100 and .5% indicates .005 out of 100.

Calculations can not be performed with numbers in percent form.
They must be changed to a decimal fraction or to a common fraction.
To change a percent to a decimal fraction, drop the percent sign and move the decimal point two places to the left.
In this example, 10.2% is equal to the decimal fraction .102.
150% is equal to the decimal fraction 1.5 or one and a half.
To change a percent to a common fraction, drop the percent sign, the number (35) becomes the numerator and 100 is the denominator.
In this example, the fraction is reduced showing that 150% equals 1 and a half.
When a percent contains a decimal fraction, you must change the decimal position and increase the denominator.
When a percent has a decimal, the percent is changed to a decimal fraction and then to a common fraction.

Once the math has been performed, it may be necessary to change a decimal or common fraction back to a percent.
To change a decimal fraction to a percent, move the decimal point two places to the right and add the percent sign.
Changing a decimal fraction to a percent is the opposite of changing a percent to a decimal fraction.
To change a common fraction to a percent, first change the fraction to a decimal, then change the decimal to a percent.
